title: Progressive cost drilldown: progressive disclosure, microcopy, and visual polish for anomaly workflows
creator: Zara Martinez
description: Goal: Reduce time-to-resolution for cost anomalies by introducing progressive disclosure in the Cost Insights drilldown, clarifying microcopy, and applying a focused visual polish for the anomaly workflow. This ticket covers design decisions, a prototype handoff, accessibility checks, and post-review redlines for engineering handoff. The scope includes: 1) A collapsed overview state for anomalies that surfaces only top-level signals, 2) An expandable stepper-style drilldown with clear affordances for exploring root causes (model, region, route, time window), 3) Microcopy bank for each state (collapsed, expanded, empty state, error state, rate-limited), 4) Visual polish for token/cost sparklines and threshold badges, 5) QA checklist and acceptance criteria for the rollout feature flag and canary deployment in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed anomaly card displays top 3 signals and single-line reason with action CTA 'Investigate'
Expanding a card reveals stepper with breadcrumb path: Anomaly → Candidate routes → Token distribution → Model variant
Microcopy has been copyedited and approved by PM and comms; strings provided in Figma and Confluence
Design passes keyboard navigation and screen-reader label checks (WCAG 2.1 AA) per a11y brief
Final Figma file exported with tokens and a dev-spec layer; PR in GitHub references the Figma frame
Feature flag exists in Console and can be toggled for canary orgs; QA run on flagged and unflagged states
dev_notes: Key tokens: anomaly-badge-(green|amber|red), sparklines-small, compact-card. Use existing cost-tile component but add an 'expand' affordance with aria-expanded and role=button. Backend endpoints: /costs/anomalies (summary), /costs/anomalies/{id}/breakdown. Suggest lightweight client-side caching for expanded state to avoid repeat queries during quick navigation.
qa_checks: Verify collapsed state only requests summary endpoint
Keyboard focus order through card → expand control → stepper → CTA
Screen reader reads: 'Anomaly: cost spike in Route X. Investigate button.'
Visual diff against baseline for badge size and sparkline stroke weight
Toggle feature flag: ensure no visible regressions when disabled
